# Predictive Personalization — ML-driven product recommendations for e-commerce stores

Curated by Skill Harbor — @finsilabs's predictive-personalization skill, listed here with credit to its creator: a practical playbook for adding machine-learning personalization to an e-commerce store without reinventing the wheel. It walks the agent through choosing the right personalization tool by store size (Rebuy or LimeSpot for small stores, Nosto for mid-market, Dynamic Yield for enterprise), setting up "Recommended for You" widgets and cart cross-sells per platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce), configuring dynamic personalized product blocks in Klaviyo email flows, measuring impact with A/B testing targets (widget CTR > 5%, AOV lift > 5%), and — for headless stores with 100k+ monthly visitors — a blueprint for a custom recommendation engine (behavioral event collection, Redis real-time profiles, nightly co-purchase similarity jobs, cold-start fallbacks). Honest caveats: the recommended apps are paid (roughly $18–$1000+/mo per the skill's own table) — free or low-cost paths are covered for WooCommerce and new stores; the custom-engine blueprint is a real engineering project, not a weekend task. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
